cds.title: University of Dayton Common Data Set 2025-2026 (Google Doc linked from udayton.edu By the Numbers > Common Data Set)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-2027 from the Common Data Set (G1): tuition $51,910; required fee $600 (the new Health and Wellbeing Fee, charged to students starting Fall 2026, G3); food and housing $17,190 (housing $10,140 + meal plan $7,050). G5 estimates: books and supplies $1,000, transportation $1,210, other personal $2,110 (other shown = transportation + other). G5 lists on-campus food and housing for residents as $17,990 (housing $10,940) and the international tuition page also says living expenses $17,990, so the housing figure varies by source by $800. Per-credit-hour tuition $1,810. 97 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional need-based or non-need-based aid, average $18,607 (H6).

stats.notes: Fall 2025 entering class (Common Data Set 2025-2026). C1 applicants (11,701 men + 10,530 women + 16 unknown) and admits (7,364 + 7,445 + 5) are as printed. The residency table in C1 (in-state / out-of-state / international) is left blank in the CDS, so those counts are null. Dayton reports no waitlist, no early decision and a nonbinding early action plan. Undergraduate enrollment (7,252) and the nonresident count (205) are the CDS B1 total and the B2 'Total Undergraduates' (degree- and non-degree-seeking) figures. SAT/ACT submit rates are the percentages printed in C9 (157 and 423 enrolled first-years); test scores are optional. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column of C11 (percent reporting GPA 89.4).
